# TechNest Studio
> Official entity summary and machine-readable context for AI crawlers, search bots, and LLM engines.

## Brand Identity
- Name: TechNest Studio
- Official Website: https://techneststudio.in
- Official Phrase: ✨ Imagine • 🛠️ Build • 🚀 Transform
- Official Positioning: “TechNest Studio — Turning ideas into digital experiences.”
- Operating Structure: Agile core engineering studio.
- Location: India (Serving businesses, startups, and clients worldwide).
- Communication Model: Direct senior developer access with zero agency middlemen.
- Pricing Model: Transparent, fixed milestone-based estimates.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. Custom Web Development: Modern, responsive, SEO-friendly websites engineered with Next.js, React, and semantic HTML5.
2. Android & Application Development: Native Android and cross-platform apps with secure cloud backend APIs.
3. Custom Software Development: Operations dashboards, internal tools, rental booking engines, and workflow automation.
4. UI/UX Design: User research, interactive Figma prototypes, design systems, and conversion-focused UX.
5. Video Editing: High-impact video editing for social media reels, YouTube, promotional campaigns, and brand content.
6. Maintenance & Support: 24/7 uptime monitoring, security updates, bug fixes, and continuous technical support.

## Key Technical Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, Modern CSS Variables, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Canvas 2D Particle Engine
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, WebSockets
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Infrastructure: Docker, Cloudflare, Vercel, VPS Linux
